scope: Application-layer member activation/profile/status/exceptions with last-administrator safeguards; no HTTP or installed image change
testFirst: New behavioral tests initially failed at import because the use case did not exist, then passed with its implementation
assertions: Only a current administrator may replace profile/status/exceptions; immutable HA linkage and actor scope are preserved
Active target requires exact fresh eligible human; unavailable deactivation needs a proven remaining administrator
Fresh actor reproof after external lookup blocks known revocation, identity mismatch or source outage
Snapshot/CAS and last eligible administrator are checked before save inside the same SQLite writer transaction
Real-file simultaneous self-suspension leaves one administrator and only one new receipt/audit/outbox effect
Real-file identical concurrent activations reuse one receipt with one effect
Current local suspension immediately blocks privilege and receipt replay; ordinary members cannot promote themselves
Archived reactivation is explicit and preserves linkage/history; malformed batches cannot invent remaining authority
Policy/member state changing during external lookup yields conflict without partial command evidence
Restart preserves authorized receipts; reordered equivalent permission rules have the same canonical payload
